'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Tom DS Imperial Law''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Law]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
